scope: Hypothesis tests, significance and practical noise threshold; source/API compatibility is not required.

mapping.feature: Welch statistic and pooled-bootstrap two-sided p-value
mapping.implementation: hypothesis::welch; analysis::compare_with_hypothesis reports method, counts, seed, repeats, p-value and family alpha
evidence: hypothesis.rs known formula and exhaustive 4^4 null oracle
hypothesis integration tests normalized process medians and report serialization

mapping.implementation: ComparisonConfig plus sparse ComparisonOptions; suite/group/case fields, attributes and CLI overrides; reported effective per-case configuration
evidence: test-cargo-bench.py cross-crate attribute and per-field CLI precedence

mapping.implementation: Finite nonnegative percentage, including zero and >=100%; practical median-interval decisions reported independently from zero-mean hypothesis decisions
evidence: hypothesis integration test 250% margin with significant zero-effect test

mapping.implementation: Explicit repeat count and seed via library, attributes and direct Cargo; nonzero Monte Carlo probability correction; degenerate null draws counted rather than removed

differences: Independent processes are sampling units; within-process batches cannot inflate significance. Criterion uses its timing samples.
Airbug uses process medians as inputs to Welch and retains its existing median-interval practical-change decisions. p-values and practical margins answer distinct questions.
Distinct constant groups with zero variance produce an unavailable Welch test. Equal constant groups yield p=1.
Paired A/B analysis is an Airbug extension; no paired comparison API was found in the audited Criterion/Divan surface, so its interval method does not block this parity item.

tracked_elsewhere.plots: Criterion t-distribution visualization remains part of plots coverage.
tracked_elsewhere.artifacts: Raw resampling distribution export and full Criterion report artifact mapping remain part of artifacts coverage.
